questions.question: French cyclist Paul Seixas made history by becoming the youngest winner of which prestigious monument classic race in Italy?
questions.explanation: Paul Seixas became the youngest rider ever to win the Giro di Lombardia by triumphing in its 120th edition.
questions.context: 2026 Il Lombardia: In cycling, French cyclist Paul Seixas wins the 120th edition of the Giro di Lombardia in Italy, becoming the youngest person to do so.

questions.question: Which French politician won more than 66% of the first-round vote in the Socialist Party primary to become their 2027 presidential election candidate?
questions.explanation: Raphaël Glucksmann secured the nomination after winning over two-thirds of the votes during the opening round of the Socialist primary.
questions.context: 2027 French presidential election: Raphaël Glucksmann is elected as a candidate in the 2027 presidential election during the Socialist Party primary, receiving more than 66% of the votes in the first round.

questions.question: Health officials in which East African country reported that nearly 300 tests had come back clear since a single Ebola fatality earlier in the month?
questions.explanation: The Kenyan health ministry confirmed zero additional Ebola infections following 293 negative diagnostic tests conducted after a patient's death.
questions.context: 2026 Ebola epidemic: The Kenyan health ministry reports that no Ebola cases have been reported since one patient died from the disease on October 5, with 293 tests conducted.

questions.story: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis
questions.question: According to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations, a commercial tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in which vital Middle Eastern waterway?
questions.explanation: British maritime monitors reported that an unidentified projectile hit a tanker as it was travelling through the Strait of Hormuz.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reports that a tanker transiting in the Strait of Hormuz has been hit by an unknown projectile.

questions.question: International Animal Rescue partnered with the forestry ministry of which country to release rescued primates following devastating wildfires?
questions.explanation: The Indonesian forestry ministry collaborated with the animal charity to return eight rescued orangutans to the wild.
questions.context: 2026 Indonesia wildfires: The Indonesian forestry ministry and International Animal Rescue release eight orangutans rescued from wildfires into a protected wildforest in West Kalimantan after fires destroyed habitat near plantations.
